Tunnistuskaavio: mistä tunnistan, mitä l: Recognition chart: how do I tell which law to use? Draw the circuit diagram first and see which sign in the task fits. Charge flows in a time: the current is the charge divided by the time. Voltage and current are known: the resistance follows from Ohm's law, the voltage is the resistance times the current. Dimensions and material of a wire: the resistance is the resistivity times the length divided by the cross-sectional area. Connected in series: the current is the same and the total resistance is the sum of the resistances. Connected in parallel: the voltage is the same and the reciprocal of the total resistance is the sum of the reciprocals. Current branches: the currents into a junction add up to the currents out of it. Closed loop: the sum of the voltages is zero. Power or energy of a device: the power is the voltage times the current. A battery has internal resistance: the terminal voltage is the emf minus the product of the internal resistance and the current.
